# Historical Source3 Guard fixture

These six exact source inputs preserve the closed Source3 editor740 Guard and
its matching private/public headers. They are test-only historical sources, not
an application engine or current canonical source. The pixel bootstrap probe
continues all 21 cases plus its historical canonical Gate confirmation and old
counterfactual against this fixed version after the canonical actions API moves
forward. The new rich bootstrap probe separately checks the actual new canonical
Guard and its matching actions private header. SOURCE-PROOF.json records hashes
and the original successful source snapshot. No fixture file is a runtime SDK.
